title_en: Fall 2026 Recruitment of New Students for the AI Semiconductor Interdisciplinary Major
summary: This notice announces the recruitment of new students for the Interdisciplinary Major in Artificial Intelligence Semiconductors for Fall 2026. The details are in two attached files, which were not read; the notice contains no further text.
applies_to: New entrants to the Interdisciplinary Major in Artificial Intelligence Semiconductors for Fall 2026, as stated in the title. No further eligibility conditions are stated in the notice text.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 Recruitment of New Students for the Interdisciplinary Major [융합전공] in Artificial Intelligence Semiconductors [인공지능반도체]

Attachments (2):
[Attachment 1] Interdisciplinary Major Application Form (Freshmen) [융합전공 신청서(신입생)].hwp (44 KB)
[Attachment 2] Interdisciplinary Major Application and Cancellation Manual (for Enrolled Students) [융합전공 신청 및 취소 매뉴얼(재학생용)].pdf (882 KB)

Translator's note: The notice contains no body text beyond the title and the list of attachments. The contents of the two attached files were not read, so any eligibility requirements, application periods, deadlines and procedures they may contain are not included here. Please open the attachments in the original notice or contact the department office for details. No contact details are given in the notice text.
